plainName: Annuity plans for a pension from an approved fund
summary: What you pay out of taxable income for an annuity plan of the Life Insurance Corporation or another insurer, to receive a pension from an approved pension fund, is deducted. It is not a deduction of its own any more: it counts towards the one investments ceiling together with the other investments and your own pension contribution. Only the old regime allows it.

routes.name: An annuity plan for a pension
routes.description: What you paid in the year counts towards the investments ceiling.

disqualifiers.description: Not available in the default regime.
